2	## A7 Step 5, plan step 1: supplemental timing probe (CHANGE-BRIEF.md Revision 1, "Evidence split").
3	## Not counted. Never loads or instantiates the game. Each run instantiates its own copy of
4	## player_visuals.tscn under a stand-in parent (Node2D, physics priority 0, the way Player will sit above
5	## PlayerVisuals) and a late hook (Node, physics priority 1000, the pattern of TickHook in test_a7_pins.gd).
6	## The stand-in's _physics_process makes the scheduled AnimationPlayer calls (play / seek / pause), where
7	## player.gd will make them; nothing else in this probe calls playback. No clip is built, keyed or
8	## modified: the probe only reads clip values (value_track_interpolate) for the expected rig values.
9	## Headless: positions and node properties are read; nothing is drawn. Scripted calls, not a playtest.
10	## Engine behaviour that differs from the plan's assumptions is a finding (printed), not a failure.
11	## Exit 1 only if the probe itself cannot run (missing scene, node, clip or track; a tick not logged).
12	##
13	## Per tick: EARLY = current_animation_position read in the stand-in before any call that tick;
14	## MID = read right after the call (call ticks only); LATE = read in the late hook, after the stand-in
15	## and the AnimationPlayer have both updated that tick.
16	
17	const SCENE_PATH := "res://features/player/player_visuals.tscn"
18	const LOWER_SCALE_PATH := "FacingPivot/LandRig/LowerPivot:scale"
19	const UPPER_POS_PATH := "FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot:position"
20	const UPPER_SCALE_PATH := "FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot:scale"
21	const F := 1.0 / 60.0
22	const PRE := 3            # stand-in ticks before entry (n = 0 is the entry tick)
23	const PAUSE_LEN := 10     # paused ticks: n = p .. p + PAUSE_LEN - 1; resume on n = p + PAUSE_LEN
24	const SCOOT_TICKS := 32   # SCOOT ticks logged from entry (and again from a resume): more than two cycles
25	const POST := 2           # LAND ticks logged after the expected time reaches 8/60 (informational)
26	const TOL_T := 1e-6
27	const TOL_V := 1e-4
28	
29	class StandIn extends Node2D:
30		## Stands in for Player (priority 0, parent of PlayerVisuals).
31		var s := 0
32		var on_tick: Callable
33		func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
34			on_tick.call(s)
35			s += 1
36	
37	class TickHook extends Node:
38		## Priority 1000: runs after the stand-in and the AnimationPlayer in every physics tick.
39		var on_tick: Callable
40		func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
41			on_tick.call()

96	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- schedule and expectations
97	
98	func pause_at() -> int:
99		return int(spec["pause"])
100	
101	func logical_c(n: int) -> int:
102		## Active ticks since entry. Frozen at the last active tick while paused.
103		var p := pause_at()
104		if p < 0 or n < p:
105			return n
106		if n < p + PAUSE_LEN:
107			return p - 1
108		return n - PAUSE_LEN
109	
110	func phase(n: int) -> int:
111		return int(spec["k"]) + logical_c(n)
112	
113	func tick_paused(n: int) -> bool:
114		var p := pause_at()
115		return p >= 0 and n >= p and n < p + PAUSE_LEN
116	
117	func expected_time(n: int) -> float:
118		if spec["clip"] == "scoot":
119			return float(posmod(phase(n), 14)) / 60.0
120		return float(mini(phase(n), 8)) / 60.0
121	
122	func counted(n: int) -> bool:
123		return spec["clip"] == "scoot" or phase(n) <= 8
124	
125	func last_n() -> int:
126		var extra := PAUSE_LEN if pause_at() >= 0 else 0
127		if spec["clip"] == "scoot":
128			var from := (pause_at() + PAUSE_LEN) if pause_at() >= 0 else 0
129			return from + SCOOT_TICKS - 1
130		return (8 - int(spec["k"])) + extra + POST
131	
132	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- per-tick work
133	
134	func enter(t: float) -> void:
135		var clip := StringName(spec["clip"])
136		match spec["method"]:
137			"R1":
138				ap.play(clip)
139				ap.seek(t, true)
140			"R2":
141				ap.play(clip)
142				ap.seek(t, false)
143			"R3":
144				ap.play(clip)

146	func _stand_tick(s: int) -> void:
147		if not active:
148			return
149		cur_n = s - PRE
150		early_stamp = Engine.get_physics_frames()
151		early = pos_now()
152		early_playing = ap.is_playing()
153		call_name = "-"
154		var p := pause_at()
155		if cur_n == 0:
156			enter(float(spec["k"]) * F)
157			call_name = "entry"
158		elif p >= 0 and cur_n == p:
159			ap.pause()
160			call_name = "pause"
161		elif p >= 0 and cur_n == p + PAUSE_LEN:
162			enter(expected_time(cur_n))
163			call_name = "resume"
164		if call_name != "-":
165			mid = pos_now()
166			mid_frame = scoot_sprite.frame
167			mid_lower = lower.scale
168		else:
169			mid = NAN
170			mid_frame = -1
171			mid_lower = Vector2(NAN, NAN)
172	
173	func _late_tick() -> void:
174		if not active or done or cur_n < 0:
175			return
176		var tick := Engine.get_physics_frames()
177		if early_stamp != tick:
178			harness_fail("stand-in did not run on physics tick %d (run %s)" % [tick, run_id])
179			done = true
180			return
181		var n := cur_n
182		var late := pos_now()
183		var exp_t := expected_time(n)
184		var ph := phase(n)
185		var frame := scoot_sprite.frame
186		var lo := lower.scale
187		var up := upper.position
188		var us := upper.scale
189		var ok_a := absf(late - exp_t) <= TOL_T   # false for NAN
190		var ok_b := false
191		var exp_str := ""
192		var exp_cell := -1
193		var rig_diff := 0.0
194		if spec["clip"] == "scoot":
195			exp_cell = 0 if posmod(ph, 14) < 7 else 1
196			ok_b = frame == exp_cell
197			exp_str = "exp_frame=%d exp_cell=%d" % [posmod(ph, 14), exp_cell]
198		else:
199			var el: Vector2 = land_anim.value_track_interpolate(tr_lower, exp_t)
200			var eu: Vector2 = land_anim.value_track_interpolate(tr_upos, exp_t)
201			var es: Vector2 = land_anim.value_track_interpolate(tr_uscale, exp_t)
202			rig_diff = maxf(maxf(absf(lo.x - el.x), absf(lo.y - el.y)), maxf(maxf(absf(up.x - eu.x), absf(up.y - eu.y)), maxf(absf(us.x - es.x), absf(us.y - es.y))))
203			ok_b = rig_diff <= TOL_V
204			exp_str = "exp_frame=%d exp_lower=%s exp_upos=%s exp_uscale=%s rig_maxdiff=%.9f" % [mini(ph, 8), v2s(el), v2s(eu), v2s(es), rig_diff]
205		var paused := tick_paused(n)
206		var cnt := counted(n)
207		var line := "TICK run=%s n=%d phys=%d c=%d call=%s paused=%s counted=%s early=%.12f mid=%.12f late=%.12f cur=\"%s\" assigned=\"%s\" playing=%s frame=%d lower_scale=%s upper_pos=%s upper_scale=%s exp_t=%.12f %s ok_a=%s ok_b=%s" % [
208			run_id, n, tick, logical_c(n), call_name, paused, cnt, early, mid, late,
209			String(ap.current_animation), String(ap.assigned_animation), ap.is_playing(), frame,
210			v2s(lo), v2s(up), v2s(us), exp_t, exp_str, ok_a, ok_b]
211		print(line)
212		ticks_logged += 1
213		rows.append({"n": n, "early": early, "early_playing": early_playing, "mid": mid, "mid_frame": mid_frame,
214			"mid_lower": mid_lower, "late": late, "call": call_name, "paused": paused, "counted": cnt,
215			"exp_t": exp_t, "phase": ph, "frame": frame, "exp_cell": exp_cell, "lower": lo, "upos": up, "uscale": us,
216			"rig_diff": rig_diff, "ok_a": ok_a, "ok_b": ok_b, "cur": String(ap.current_animation),
217			"assigned": String(ap.assigned_animation), "playing": ap.is_playing(), "line": line})
218		if n >= last_n():
219			done = true

223	func make_specs() -> Array[Dictionary]:
224		var out: Array[Dictionary] = []
225		for m in ["R1", "R2"]:
226			for k in range(14):
227				out.append({"clip": "scoot", "method": m, "k": k, "pause": -1})
228		out.append({"clip": "scoot", "method": "R3", "k": 0, "pause": -1})

283			print("SETUP callback_mode_process=%d (PHYSICS=%d) physics_ticks_per_second=%d physics_delta=%.12f ap_priority=%d playervisuals_priority=%d standin_priority=%d hook_priority=%d scoot_length=%.12f land_length=%.12f" % [
284				ap.callback_mode_process, AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS, Engine.physics_ticks_per_second,
285				1.0 / Engine.physics_ticks_per_second, ap.process_physics_priority, visuals.process_physics_priority,
286				stand.process_physics_priority, hook.process_physics_priority, scoot_len, land_anim.length])
287		print("RUN %s clip=%s method=%s k=%d pause=%d start_phys=%d start_frame=%d" % [run_id, sp["clip"], sp["method"], int(sp["k"]), int(sp["pause"]), Engine.get_physics_frames(), Engine.get_process_frames()])

302			else:

312	func circ(d: float) -> float:
313		if spec["clip"] == "scoot":
314			return fposmod(d + scoot_len / 2.0, scoot_len) - scoot_len / 2.0
315		return d
316	
317	func bump(dict: Dictionary, key: String) -> void:
318		dict[key] = int(dict.get(key, 0)) + 1
319	
320	func evaluate() -> void:
321		var m: String = spec["method"]
322		var clip: String = spec["clip"]
323		var key := "%s/%s" % [m, clip]
324		if not method_agg.has(m):
325			method_agg[m] = {"runs": 0, "entries": 0, "resumes": 0, "ticks": 0, "fail_a": 0, "fail_b": 0, "first_fail": ""}
326		var agg: Dictionary = method_agg[m]
327		agg["runs"] += 1
328		agg["entries"] += 1
329		var p := pause_at()
330		if p >= 0:
331			agg["resumes"] += 1
332		if not a1_counts.has(key):
333			a1_counts[key] = {"after": 0, "before": 0, "other": 0}
334		if not pf6.has(m):
335			pf6[m] = {"swap_ticks": 0, "cell1": 0, "cell0": 0}
336		var incr := PackedStringArray()
337		var a1_samples := 0
338		var run_fail_a := 0
339		var run_fail_b := 0
340		for i in range(rows.size()):
341			var r: Dictionary = rows[i]
342			var n: int = r["n"]
343			if i > 0:
344				incr.append("%.6f" % ((float(r["late"]) - float(rows[i - 1]["late"])) * 60.0))
345			if r["counted"]:
346				agg["ticks"] += 1
347				if not r["ok_a"]:
348					agg["fail_a"] += 1
349					run_fail_a += 1
350					print("POSMISS run=%s n=%d call=%s paused=%s exp_t=%.12f late=%.12f diff_frames=%.6f" % [run_id, n, r["call"], r["paused"], r["exp_t"], r["late"], (float(r["late"]) - float(r["exp_t"])) * 60.0])
351				if not r["ok_b"]:
352					agg["fail_b"] += 1
353					run_fail_b += 1
354					if clip == "scoot":
355						print("CELLMISS run=%s n=%d call=%s paused=%s exp_t=%.12f late=%.12f exp_cell=%d frame=%d" % [run_id, n, r["call"], r["paused"], r["exp_t"], r["late"], r["exp_cell"], r["frame"]])
356					else:
357						print("RIGMISS run=%s n=%d call=%s paused=%s exp_t=%.12f late=%.12f rig_maxdiff=%.9f lower=%s upos=%s uscale=%s" % [run_id, n, r["call"], r["paused"], r["exp_t"], r["late"], r["rig_diff"], v2s(r["lower"]), v2s(r["upos"]), v2s(r["uscale"])])
358				if (not r["ok_a"] or not r["ok_b"]) and agg["first_fail"] == "":
359					agg["first_fail"] = r["line"]
360			# Predicted failure 6: every tick whose expected time is exactly 7/60.
361			if clip == "scoot" and posmod(int(r["phase"]), 14) == 7:
362				pf6[m]["swap_ticks"] += 1
363				if int(r["frame"]) == 1:
364					pf6[m]["cell1"] += 1
365				else:
366					pf6[m]["cell0"] += 1
367				print("SWAP run=%s n=%d call=%s paused=%s exp_t=7/60 late=%.12f late_minus_7/60=%.15f frame=%d cell1=%s" % [run_id, n, r["call"], r["paused"], r["late"], float(r["late"]) - 7.0 / 60.0, r["frame"], "yes" if int(r["frame"]) == 1 else "NO"])
368			# A1: steady playback ticks (no call this tick, not paused, playing at EARLY, counted, n >= 1).
369			if i > 0 and r["call"] == "-" and not r["paused"] and r["counted"] and r["early_playing"] and not rows[i - 1]["paused"]:
370				var d_le := circ(float(r["late"]) - float(r["early"]))
371				var d_ep := circ(float(r["early"]) - float(rows[i - 1]["late"]))
372				var cls := "other"
373				if absf(d_le - F) <= TOL_T and absf(d_ep) <= 1e-9:
374					cls = "after"
375				elif absf(d_le) <= 1e-9 and absf(d_ep - F) <= TOL_T:
376					cls = "before"
377				bump(a1_counts[key], cls)
378				if a1_samples < 2 or cls == "other":
379					a1_samples += 1
380					print("A1 run=%s n=%d prev_late=%.12f early=%.12f late=%.12f early_minus_prev_late_frames=%.6f late_minus_early_frames=%.6f class=%s" % [run_id, n, rows[i - 1]["late"], r["early"], r["late"], d_ep * 60.0, d_le * 60.0, cls])
381		# Entry tick.
382		var e: Dictionary = rows[0]
383		var t0 := float(spec["k"]) * F
384		var adv := "%.6f" % ((float(e["late"]) - t0) * 60.0)
385		if not entry_adv.has(m):
386			entry_adv[m] = {}
387		bump(entry_adv[m], adv)
388		var vis := ("frame=%d exp_cell=%d mid_frame=%d" % [e["frame"], e["exp_cell"], e["mid_frame"]]) if clip == "scoot" else ("lower=%s mid_lower=%s rig_maxdiff=%.9f" % [v2s(e["lower"]), v2s(e["mid_lower"]), e["rig_diff"]])
389		print("ENTRY run=%s method=%s t=%.12f early=%.12f mid=%.12f late=%.12f late_minus_t_frames=%s %s cur=\"%s\" playing=%s ok_a=%s ok_b=%s" % [run_id, m, t0, e["early"], e["mid"], e["late"], adv, vis, e["cur"], e["playing"], e["ok_a"], e["ok_b"]])
390		print("INCR run=%s late_increments_frames_from_n1=[%s]" % [run_id, ",".join(incr)])
391		# Pause and resume.
392		if p >= 0:
393			var ref := float(rows[p - 1]["late"])
394			var froze := true
395			var curs := {}
396			var assigned := {}
397			var playing := {}
398			var paused_lates := PackedStringArray()
399			for n in range(p, p + PAUSE_LEN):
400				var r: Dictionary = rows[n]
401				if absf(float(r["late"]) - ref) > 1e-12 or absf(float(r["early"]) - ref) > 1e-12:
402					froze = false
403				curs["\"%s\"" % r["cur"]] = true
404				assigned["\"%s\"" % r["assigned"]] = true
405				playing[str(r["playing"])] = true
406				paused_lates.append("%.12f" % r["late"])
407			var rr: Dictionary = rows[p + PAUSE_LEN]
408			var rt := float(rr["exp_t"])
409			var radv := "%.6f" % ((float(rr["late"]) - rt) * 60.0)
410			if not resume_adv.has(m):
411				resume_adv[m] = {}

	collider.position = Vector2(0, -size.y / 2.0)

func reset_at(spawn: Vector2) -> void:
	position = spawn
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	last_floor_tick = -1000
	jumps = 0
	was_grounded = true   # placing the jelly on a plate is not a landing
	just_landed = false
	just_hopped = false
	idle_ticks = 0
	land_ticks = 0
	hop_ticks = -1
	require_fresh_press()
	_update_pose()

func require_fresh_press() -> void:
	## The next hop needs a new jump press: a held key must be released first, and a press
	## that arrived with the key that changed the state (skip, restart, unpause) is ignored.
	## A held direction is ignored the same way, so the skip or restart key never moves the jelly.
	require_jump_release = true
	require_axis_release = true
	jump_request_tick = -1000
	opportunity_consumed = false
	test_jump_pressed = false
	ignore_press_through_frame = Engine.get_physics_frames() + 1

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	just_landed = false
	just_hopped = false
	if not enabled:
		_update_pose()
		return
	tick += 1
	var axis := test_axis if test_control else Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	if is_zero_approx(axis):
		require_axis_release = false
	elif require_axis_release:
		axis = 0.0
	var held := test_jump_held if test_control else Input.is_action_pressed("jump")
	var pressed := test_jump_pressed if test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump")
	test_jump_pressed = false
	if pressed and Engine.get_physics_frames() <= ignore_press_through_frame:
		pressed = false
	idle_ticks = 0 if (not is_zero_approx(axis) or held or pressed) else idle_ticks + 1
	if not held:
		require_jump_release = false
	if is_on_floor() and velocity.y >= 0.0:
		last_floor_tick = tick
		opportunity_consumed = false
	if pressed and not require_jump_release:
		jump_request_tick = tick
	var rate: float = tuning.acceleration if not is_zero_approx(axis) else tuning.deceleration
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, axis * tuning.speed, rate * delta)
	if not is_zero_approx(axis):
		facing = signf(axis)
	velocity.y = minf(velocity.y + tuning.gravity * delta, tuning.terminal_velocity)
	if not opportunity_consumed and tick - last_floor_tick <= tuning.coyote_ticks and tick - jump_request_tick <= tuning.buffer_ticks:
		velocity.y = tuning.jump_velocity
		opportunity_consumed = true
		jump_request_tick = -1000
		jumps += 1
		just_hopped = true
		hop_ticks = 0
		# Grounded (or coyote) -> airborne after a fresh jump press: the only place SFX-HOP plays.
		if sound:
			sound.play("SFX-HOP")
	move_and_slide()
	var grounded := is_on_floor()
	if grounded and not was_grounded:
		just_landed = true
		land_ticks = T.LAND_TICKS
		hop_ticks = -1
	elif land_ticks > 0:
		land_ticks -= 1
	if not grounded and hop_ticks >= 0:
		hop_ticks += 1
	was_grounded = grounded
	_update_pose()

func choose_pose() -> String:
	## CHARACTER-SHEET.md pose table. Worried always overrides bored.
	if override_pose != "":
		return override_pose
	if not was_grounded:
		if hop_ticks >= 0 and hop_ticks <= T.ANTIC_TICKS:
			return "ANTIC"   # visual only: shown at takeoff, no input delay
		return "RISE" if velocity.y < 0.0 else "FALL"
	if land_ticks > 0:
		return "LAND"
	if absf(velocity.x) > 8.0:
		return "SCOOT-A" if (tick / T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME)) % 2 == 0 else "SCOOT-B"
	if worried:
		return "WORRY"
	if idle_ticks >= T.ticks(T.BORED_DELAY):
		return "BORED"
	return "IDLE"

func _update_pose() -> void:
	pose = choose_pose()
	sprite.texture = textures[pose]
	sprite.flip_h = facing < 0.0   # drawn facing right; keeps the last direction moved
	var wanted := LOW if pose in LOW_POSES else STANDING
	if wanted != box:
		set_box(wanted)
	_update_visuals()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- A7 visual layer
## CHANGE-BRIEF.md (A7), "Scene, authority and states" and Revision 1. Everything below only reads
## gameplay state (pose, facing, tick, land_ticks, just_landed, enabled); it never writes it.
## The AnimationPlayer alone writes ScootSprite.frame and the rig pivots; this code writes only the
## facing mirror, the three visibility flags and the playback calls.

const VISUALS_SCENE = preload("res://features/player/player_visuals.tscn")
## Pose -> clip. Every other pose shows the original sprite with no clip.
const POSE_CLIPS := {"LAND": &"land", "SCOOT-A": &"scoot", "SCOOT-B": &"scoot"}
const CLIP_FPS := 60.0   # both clips: step 1/60 s, one physics tick per timeline frame

var visuals: Node2D
var facing_pivot: Node2D
var scoot_node: Node2D
var land_rig: Node2D
var anim: AnimationPlayer
var clip: StringName = &""        # the clip this code last entered, or "" for the original sprite
var clip_held: bool = false       # the player was disabled with a clip selected: re-enter when enabled

func _update_visuals() -> void:
	if visuals == null:
		visuals = VISUALS_SCENE.instantiate()
		add_child(visuals)
		facing_pivot = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot")
		scoot_node = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot/Scoot")
		land_rig = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot/LandRig")
		anim = visuals.get_node("AnimationPlayer")
	facing_pivot.transform = Transform2D(Vector2(facing, 0), Vector2(0, 1), Vector2.ZERO)
	var want: StringName = POSE_CLIPS.get(pose, &"")
	scoot_node.visible = want == &"scoot"
	land_rig.visible = want == &"land"
	sprite.visible = want == &""
	if want == &"":
		# Leaving a clip (hop, walk-off, override, tick-8 hand-off, reset): stop it.
		if clip != &"":
			anim.stop()
		clip = &""
		clip_held = false
		return
	if not enabled:
		# Paused or locked with a clip selected: freeze it; it re-enters on the first enabled tick.
		if clip != want and clip != &"":
			anim.stop()
		clip = want
		if anim.is_playing():
			anim.pause()
		clip_held = true
		return
	var entry := want != clip or clip_held or (want == &"land" and just_landed)
	if not entry:
		return   # steady tick, including SCOOT-A <-> SCOOT-B: no call
	if clip != &"" and clip != want:
		anim.stop()
	anim.play(want)
	anim.seek(_clip_time(want), true)
	clip = want
	clip_held = false

func _clip_time(c: StringName) -> float:
	## The synced entry time: LAND (8 - land_ticks) / 60, SCOOT (tick % 14) / 60.
	if c == &"land":
		return float(T.LAND_TICKS - land_ticks) / CLIP_FPS
	return float(tick % (2 * T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME))) / CLIP_FPS

## Probe changes
I only added to the probe. The 40 existing R1/R2/R3 runs and their scoring are unchanged. I added 42 hand-off runs: H0, H1 and H2 at each phase k = 0..13.

Each hand-off run first starts `land` with `play + seek(0, true)` 8 ticks before the switch, the way the game does on touchdown. It checks that `land` is playing at 7/60 on the tick before the switch, which is the game's tick-8 situation; if not, the harness fails the run. Then, in one stand-in tick, it switches to `scoot` at k/60 with the variant. It scores the switch tick and the 31 ticks after with the same rule as before: LATE within 1e-6 s of the expected time, and the exact expected cell.

## Hand-off results (identical at 30, 60 and 144)

| Variant | Runs failing | Ticks failing time / cell (of 448) | First failing tick |
|---|---|---|---|
| H0 `stop()` (current code) | 14 of 14 | 448 / 64 | n = 0 (the switch tick) at every k |
| H1 `stop(true)` | 14 of 14 | 448 / 64 | n = 0 at every k |
| H2 no `stop()` | 14 of 14 | 448 / 64 | n = 0 at every k |

- **What happens:** In every variant, the time read straight after `seek` is exactly k/60. The AnimationPlayer's own update later in the same tick then moves it on by 1/60. Example, H1 at k = 7, 60 fps: mid 0.116666666667, late 0.133333333333. The same check line shows 1.0 frame of extra advance for k = 0..12 and −13.0 for k = 13, which is the same one-tick advance wrapped past the loop end.
- **So scoot runs one tick ahead on every tick after a hand-off.** The cell is still correct on most ticks, but it is wrong on the 64 ticks around each A/B swap. This matches the state-test failure in 74fe4b5.
- **The difference from a fresh entry:** a start from stopped (R1) still meets the rule at all three rates, with 0 failures. The extra advance happens only when the player was already running a clip when `play(scoot)` was called. `stop()` and `stop(true)` don't prevent it.
- **One side difference:** after H0, the hidden land rig shows frame-0 values (lower scale 1.05, 0.85). After H1 and H2 it is left where land stopped (lower scale 1.009375, 0.975).
- **Other numbers unchanged:** with 7/60 expected, cell 1 showed on all 32 hand-off ticks for each variant. R1 is 593 ticks with 0 failures, R2 has 9 cell failures, R3 has 39 time and 11 cell failures. Each probe run logged 82 runs and 2585 ticks.

- **Steps 3–5 (player.gd, state test, structure test, full re-run):** not run, because the rule says to stop when no variant passes. `player.gd` is unchanged.

The brief's rule, zero ticks of difference on entry, can't be met on a direct LAND → SCOOT switch with any of the approved variants. Two possible next variants are seeking to `t − 1/60` only on a clip-to-clip switch, or finding a call that clears the "already playing" state. I haven't tested either; the probe can test them the same way if you approve a variant. Either one would need a dated revision to the brief, which I'd leave to you.
